proposal_instruction: Propose at most four one-shot rules applied identically to stack_blocks_two and handover_block. The incumbent is frozen LingBot-VLA with unmodified native instructions, RGB and robot state, predicting50 EEF waypoints per call; max24calls/1200 native actions. Published10case development panel stack2/5 and handover1/5, no current accepted shared update. Do not repeat prefix search or modify VLA prompts/actions. Each rule is checked before a VLA call, fires at most once when min_vla_calls and the selected arm normalized gripper range hold. At most one rule fires per cycle; evaluation then continues with fixed50. Relative movement uses current observed end-effector XYZ plus your bounded delta, same orientation/gripper; native planner, at most10waypoints. set_gripper uses10native actions, delta must be[0,0,0]. Max offset peraxis0.08m and Euclidean norm0.10m. No object truth poses or arbitrary world targets. All native skill actions share the1200horizon and failures count; there is no automatic repair/retry. A closed gripper is NOT proof of a held object. Task-specific branching, stored trajectories and scene coordinates are forbidden. You may abstain with an empty rules list if evidence cannot justify a reusable candidate. Otherwise choose ONE plausible shared patch based on the supplied allowed initial observations. This is a finite exploratory proposal, not a claim of success. Submit with submit_patch. No prose or extra tool needed.
